card.name: Extended-release labels after drug names
card.fires_on: The release-type word right after a drug name, such as ER or SR after nifedipine or diltiazem, or release after 'extended'. It fires in label text naming extended-release forms.

modes.label: ER/SR abbreviation
modes.description: The abbreviation ER or SR placed directly after a drug name with its dose.
modes.example: In healthy volunteers receiving single dose of 20 mg nifedipine<< ER>> and benazepril 10

modes.label: Extended-release wording
modes.description: The word release, or extended, in the phrase extended-release tablets after a drug name.
modes.example: Methylphenidate hydrochloride extended<<-release>> tablets should be taken once daily in the
